title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Patient presents today for routine follow-up regarding known kidney impairment.

History of Present Illness
The patient reports feeling generally well since the last visit, with no new complaints of swelling or shortness of breath. The primary focus remains on the management of chronic kidney disease, specifically noted at stage 3b. He denies any recent changes in diet or activity level. He reports adequate fluid intake and continues to monitor his blood pressure as instructed.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10 mg daily
Furosemide 20 mg daily

Exam
Vitals are stable, with blood pressure reading of 138/84 mmHg. Cardiac exam reveals regular rhythm with no murmurs or rubs. Pulmonary exam is clear to auscultation bilaterally. Abdominal exam is soft and non-tender. Skin exam reveals no rashes or signs of acute distress.

Assessment
Chronic kidney disease, stage 3b.

Plan
Continue current medications as prescribed. Follow up in three months to recheck labs and vital signs. Patient educated on maintaining a low-sodium diet and ensuring adequate hydration status.
explanations: CKD stage 3b: N18.32 (maps to a higher V28 HCC than 3a).

distractors.why: 3a is less severe than the documented 3b.
Stage 3b is documented; do not use unspecified stage 3.
